matrix.condition: scenario file exists, OFFLINE_SAFE=false on its own line, mode 755
matrix.rationale: Written fresh in this attempt; the file already satisfies its own convention check once created, so this row is a control on the artifact's own shape, not a behavior fix.

matrix.condition: pair install --source <pinned https release zip> in a clean workspace
matrix.rationale: Exercises the real content-ops HTTP download path end to end against a real GitHub release asset; observed passing against current, unmodified production code (no defect — this is coverage-only).

matrix.condition: non-TTY captured stdout of Test 2's install
matrix.expected: 'downloading v0.4.3 from GitHub' and 'KB v0.4.3 installed at' present
matrix.rationale: download-ui.ts's announceDownload/announceSuccess run unconditionally (not gated on isTTY) — verified by direct read of kb-installer.ts; asserts the descoped (2026-09-18) replacement class only.

matrix.condition: pair update --source <same pinned URL> on the workspace Test 2 installed
matrix.rationale: customUrl bypasses the 'ready' cache check in ensureKBAvailable, so update always re-fetches — confirmed by direct read of kb-availability.ts and by running it.

matrix.expected: non-zero exit, 'KB source path not found' error
matrix.rationale: detectSourceType falls through to local-path resolution, which fails as a non-existent path — a different failure shape from the two protocol rejections, so kept as its own row rather than merged with R5a/R5b.

matrix.condition: pair install --source https://127.0.0.1:<local self-signed HTTPS fixture>/missing.zip (404)
matrix.rationale: 404 is absent from RETRYABLE_PATTERNS in retryable-download.ts, so isRetryableError returns false and downloadWithRetry rethrows on the first attempt. Fixture is a local self-signed HTTPS server (the CLI's HttpClientService always calls https.get, even for an http:// URL, which throws before reaching the network — verified directly), never a third-party endpoint, per the story's Business Rules.

matrix.condition: pair install --source https://127.0.0.1:<closed local port>/kb.zip (connection refused)
matrix.rationale: econnrefused matches RETRYABLE_PATTERNS, so the full retry budget runs before the final rethrow. Measured live: 7s observed.

matrix.condition: run-all.sh --offline-only with remote-source-resolution.sh present and declaring OFFLINE_SAFE=false
matrix.rationale: Generic pre-existing mechanism (story #400/#424), unmodified; observed passing live against the new scenario with no code change needed.

matrix.condition: scripts/smoke-tests/scenarios/runner-outcomes.sh's UNCOVERED invariant, run at HEAD with remote-source-resolution.sh present and UNREGISTERED in lib/ci-tests.sh
matrix.expected: green once remote-source-resolution.sh is added to CI_EXCLUDED with a reason naming the network dependency
matrix.rationale: Genuine RED at the unfixed base — the registration this AC requires does not exist yet. This is the round's discriminating witness; fixScope.mode is 'structural' (not 'test') because this row requires the implementer to actually change scripts/smoke-tests/lib/ci-tests.sh, not merely add a guard around already-correct behavior.

matrix.condition: remote-source-resolution.sh Test 8, checking scripts/smoke-tests/lib/ci-tests.sh's CI_EXCLUDED reason names 'network' and README.md documents the scenario + names 'network'
matrix.expected: both checks pass once ci-tests.sh is registered and README.md is updated
matrix.rationale: AC10's story-stated verification method ('manual read-through cross-checked against lib/ci-tests.sh') is made an executable invariant instead, so a future edit to one side cannot silently drop the other. Genuinely RED now: neither file mentions the new scenario yet.
